thread:
amy: heads up — since ~03:10 APAC we've seen p99 gen latency jump on hosted models in apac-edge; looks correlated with a handful of heavy tenants on a single rack. p50 mostly fine.
raj: which rack/az? any link to telemetry?
amy: rack r18 in apac-east-1, telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/apac/r18/latency?range=1h (sharing) — p99 went from 220ms -> 1.6s for text-gen.
ops_jake: saw a storm of long sessions from tenant:streamlytics in the last 20m, many long-context requests, big KV cache churn.
lina: KV cache evictions count spiked, then GPU mem reclaimed, then big PCIe copy spikes. possible noisy neighbor + kv regen thrashing interconnect.
raj: checking NIC tx drops and err_sums on r18 now. running: sudo ethtool -S eth0 | grep -E 'drop|tx_'
raj: output: tx_drops: 843, tx_queue_0_full: 721, rx_drops: 0.
amy: that matches tail latency spikes. if TX queue is full packets get delayed -> GPU queueing jitter.
ops_jake: can we quickly throttle streamlytics or move them to a dedicated slice? Their SLAs are standard PLG — prefer soft isolation.
lina: options: 1) apply per-tenant NIC shaping (ebpf policer) on leafs, 2) move tenant to fractional dedicated slice (costly), 3) route new allocations to apac-fallback region.
raj: eBPF policing doable as short-term patch. I can push a rate limit rule scoped to tenant id streamlytics for 5m. any objections?
amy: +1 for eBPF immediate. Also we should trigger a warm-pool refill for r19 to accept re-routed allocations.
ops_jake: re-route plan: stop scheduling new large-context allocations to r18; drain existing non-critical evictables to r19. cost hit minimal if short.
lina: note: moving will cause extra kv warmups -> regen traffic for a few minutes. try to move in small batches.
raj: pushing eBPF rule now. cmd: sudo tc qdisc add dev eth0 handle 1: root prio || sudo bpftool prog load /out/policer.o /sys/fs/bpf/policer
raj: done — applying tenant filter... filter added, rate 250Mbps peak.
sre-bot: [alert] eBPF policer applied to tenant streamlytics on r18 by raj at 03:16 UTC.
amy: watching latency — p99 dropped from 1.6s -> 380ms within ~90s. great.
ops_jake: starting phased drain: 5 nodes -> r19. tagging allocations with prefer=r19.
lina: keep an eye on r19 KV cache saturation. we'll pre-warm some slots with small synthetic requests to seed KV.
raj: NIC tx_drops down to 12 after policer.
amy: action items: 1) temporary eBPF policer until we have long-term QoS (raj) 2) infra ops to define a soft-fallback route for heavy long-context tenants (ops_jake + lina) 3) run post-mortem telemetry to tune eviction thresholds and warm-pool prefill (amy)
ops_jake: noted — I'll open a runbook PR with the fallback steps and cost estimate (expected ~2-3% extra tokens for rewarm).
amy: cost note: fractional dedicated slice estimate vs soft routing: dedicated ~+$12k/mo for this tenant; soft-route ~+$600/mo (re-warm & cross-az egress). recommend soft-route + QoS.
lina: long-term: we should auto-detect heavy kv regen patterns and trigger quota throttle or predictive pre-warm. filing ticket.
raj: also let's add telemetry alert on tx_queue_full > 100 over 1m for any rack -> auto throttle rule.
sre-bot: [task] created ticket INFRA-APAC-789 auto-throttle-on-tx-queue-full (ops_jake assigned).
amy: thanks team — keep me posted if p99 drifts back up. :thumbsup:
